# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **m155 platform readiness**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 restores Linux system-font discovery while updating platform builds for the m155 release line. This unreleased work aligns the core fork with m155, requires the current Tizen toolchain, and refreshes Windows native build provenance.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **m155 core fork cleanup integrated** — Aligns the release line with the current Skia core fork as the bundled rendering engine moves to milestone m155. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again locate fonts installed on the system. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Tizen native builds updated** — Tizen 10 packaging now uses the GCC 14.2 toolchain required for the supported native assets. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Windows native build alignment** — Windows native assets now build with the v143 toolset and validated Spectre library provenance. ([#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238))
